items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: John Lewis is a good comer. ... People don't think of John Lewis as being funky, but he's very funky.

ctx.x: Oh, was it pianos? as a pianist? Yes, I agree with that.
Especially (inaudible). as a comer, to feed you. John Lewis is a good comer.
The records with Bird. He was just superb on those.
